== Is Fiordland free? ==
Yes. Free of charge and open source (GPL-3.0).

== Is it Arch? ==
It uses the Arch Linux repositories, so most Arch guides apply. It adds its own installer, package manager, defaults and a repo for its own packages. Please do not report Fiordland-specific problems to Arch.

== How is it different from CachyOS or EndeavourOS? ==
See the [https://fiordland.apollo44.lat/compare/ comparison page].

== Can I use pacman, flatpak and paru directly? ==
Yes. tawaki is a front end; everything underneath is standard.

== Does it run games? ==
Yes. 32-bit libraries (multilib) and Vulkan drivers are set up by the installer. Install Steam with <code>tawaki install steam</code>.

== How do I update? ==
<code>tawaki update</code> in a terminal. It updates the system, Flatpaks and AUR packages in one go.

== Where do I report bugs? ==
On [https://github.com/3cfl/fiordland/issues GitHub], or on the forum if you are not sure it is a bug.
